Yampudāyi, mamaṁ sāvakā abhikkante ñāṇadassane sambhāventi: Since this is so, ‘jānaṁyevāha samaṇo gotamo—jānāmīti, passaṁyevāha samaṇo gotamo—passāmīti; Puna caparaṁ, udāyi, mamaṁ sāvakā adhipaññāya sambhāventi: Furthermore, my disciples esteem me for my higher wisdom: ‘paññavā samaṇo gotamo paramena paññākkhandhena samannāgato; taṁ vata anāgataṁ vādapathaṁ na dakkhati, uppannaṁ vā parappavādaṁ na sahadhammena niggahitaṁ niggaṇhissatīti— netaṁ ṭhānaṁ vijjati’.
